results.name: smoke: loads, SW up, knob shows, no console errors
how soon: 2-3 days / 1 week / 1 month changes a fair price from Buy to Wait, saves the choice, and offers an alert price
Impulse Check (Amazon): real page markup -> stock/deal/popularity cues from the product zones only; carousels and reviews ignored; memory + price context drive the verdict; no cue = no card
Impulse Check (Flipkart, Myntra): messages near the product title are read (timer d/h/m/s, per-size stock); menus, banners, reviews, carousels, pop-ups are not; a timer that restarts is reported
